profile_text: With a focus on construction management, this Düsseldorf-based firm provides specialized services for building projects, driving its 72.7% growth since the baseline. As a key player in the professional, scientific, and technical activities sector, the company's expertise has enabled it to expand its workforce to 19 employees by 2024. Its success can be attributed to its ability to deliver tailored construction management solutions, catering to the unique needs of its clients in the German market.
